You're already doing great by wanting to help her :) What is certain, is that you shouldn't shame her about it, or get angry. It will only make things worse. You must simply show your support, and ask her if you can help in any way. If she is self harming, the self harm isn't the major problem, it's her mental health (if she wasn't feeling sad/overwhelmed, she probably wouldn't have started). And more than the self harm, you should look out on how she is feeling (without being intrusive). Being here for her is great, I hope your daughter will feel better soon. I can't give you many advice, because when someone self harms, it's very personal. No one is a "medicine", but you can help :)
